Singularity
™
XDR
Stop threats like ransomware with a unified security platform for the entire enterprise.
Get a Demo
See the Full Picture of Your Security Posture
It’s hard to stay secure when your data lives in separate siloes. With Singularity XDR, you can ingest and normalize data from any source across your organization into a single place, enabling you to correlate across attack surfaces and understand the full context of an attack.
Respond to Incidents with Machine Speed
When it comes to preventing and remediating attacks, speed is everything. The AI-powered Singularity XDR empowers your teams with automated workflows that prevent attacks across your digital environment and instantly prioritize incidents if something breaks through.
Greater Efficiency. Lower Costs.
Other XDR solutions can come with a high price tag and limited functionality. By keeping all your data hot and leveraging the industry-leading Purple AI, Singularity XDR enables you to rapidly surface actionable security insights and get the most out of your investment.
IDC MarketScape: SentinelOne is an XDR Leader
SentinelOne's unified agent and data lake have been recognized by IDC MarketScape as key strengths. See how SentinelOne Singularity unifies prevention, detection, and response across all attack surfaces.
